answer: Locks are recorded in falcon, expire in ember, and tundra lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 5 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Anyone running 14 aliases therefore needs 133 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 501 identities would post 600 proofs and burn roughly 88 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
